# reco_role (Resource)

Manages a Reco custom RBAC role. The stable identifier is the role name. Changing the name forces the resource to be destroyed and recreated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reco_role" "soc_analyst" {
  name        = "SOC Analyst"
  description = "Read-only access for SOC team members."
  permissions = ["PERM_ALERTS_READ", "PERM_EVENT_READ", "PERM_POLICIES_READ"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique role name. Changing this forces a replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) List of permission strings granted by this role.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Fine-grained resource-level permissions attached to this role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the role was created (read-only).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. Equal to the role name.
- `type` (String) Role type (read-only), e.g. USER_ROLE_TYPE_CUSTOM.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Required:

- `permission` (String) Permission granted on the resource.
- `resource` (String) Resource identifier.
- `resource_name` (String) Display name of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = reco_role.soc_analyst
  id = "SOC Analyst"
}
```
